parameter_estimation.proposal: Discrete CPTs with symmetric Dirichlet smoothing estimated only on permitted training rows
parameter_estimation.alpha_semantics: Pseudocount per child state per parent configuration, not an unspecified equivalent-sample-size setting
parameter_estimation.estimator_library: Existing NumPy/pandas; local CPT counting and exact sum-product branch inference

discretization.policy: After training-only median imputation, compute 1/3 and 2/3 empirical quantiles; deduplicate and remove cuts at observed extrema. Intervals are left-closed at cuts (searchsorted side=right), with unbounded exterior intervals. Constant columns have one state. Reject nonfinite values and all-missing training columns.
requirements: Clinical cutoffs require a directly supporting source
Any learned cut points must be fitted inside each training fold
Define interval boundaries, tied cut points, out-of-range values and all-missing training columns
No numeric bin values may be chosen from C, T or held-out-hospital outcomes

missing_values.training_proposal: Training-only median/mode imputation before CPT counts; mode ties use first declared category; all-missing training columns raise ValueError
missing_values.inference_proposal: Omit unavailable observations from evidence and marginalize their nodes using the fitted joint distribution
missing_values.invalid_categories: Reject invalid values; do not silently treat invalid categories as missing clinical evidence
missing_values.unseen_valid_states: Use the frozen state vocabulary and smoothed CPTs; unseen numeric values use frozen interval definitions
assumptions: Imputed training values are an approximation and suppress missing-value uncertainty
Inference marginalization does not repair bias in imputation-based parameter estimates
Site-dependent missingness may be informative; neither ignorability nor clinical validity has been established

inference.proposal: Exact sum-product marginalization specialized to disease -> features plus oldpeak -> slope; sum missing independent leaves to one and explicitly sum the oldpeak/slope branch
inference.no_evidence_behavior: Return fitted root CPT P(disease); graph fixes disease as the root
inference.status: implemented_exact_branch_inference; historical synthetic and saved-prediction checks recorded in docs/bn_design.md
